verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists "Unlimited Visual Automations" as its own feature, and the MCP docs mention sequences as an account object. That supports some form of built-in multi-step automation. Nothing in the pack shows how those automations work or confirms the lifecycle elements the story names. Missing for 10: documented branching/conditional logic, documented delays between steps, documented exit rules, examples of welcome/onboarding/winback flows, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: exposes a creator's Kit account — subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments, and more
